summary: Round-7 cosmetic/symmetry pass tested at mobile viewport 390x844 with seeded localStorage (4 transfusions, 5 ferritin readings up to 2150, 5 desferal entries this week). Most cosmetic asks PASS visually: Ferritin subtitle reads 'LOG' (stored as 'Log', rendered uppercase via CSS), both calendars use DayPicker default caption ('April 2026' + chevron prev/next nav buttons, weekStartsOn=Monday, showOutsideDays hidden), Hb-chart YAxis decimal labels (7.5/7.35/7.2/7.05/6.9) render WITHOUT clipping (verified visually in screenshot), transfusion-day class still renders full slate-blue circle, desferal-day dots render under marked dates (visible under 23, 25, etc.), all weekly bar charts (fatigue, headache, diet) measure h-40 (~160px) with hidden YAxis, Hb chart measures h-48 (~192px), Diet bar tooltip shows 'Home: N' and 'Out: N' with colored dots, bottom nav has 6 items, service worker registers. ONE CRITICAL bug found: Desferal weekly strip columns are NOT aligned with monthly calendar columns — strip cell centers are spaced ~28px apart while calendar header columns are spaced ~40px apart, causing per-column drifts of [+36, +24, +12, 0, -12, -24, -36] px. The middle Thursday column aligns by accident; outer columns are wildly off.

ui_bugs.component: DesferalTracker — weekly strip alignment with monthly calendar
ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: Strip cells render at ~28px width (content-fit) instead of 42px because the strip is OUTSIDE the .rdp DOM subtree. CSS rule `.rdp { --rdp-cell-size: 42px; }` (in /app/frontend/src/index.css line 135-140) only defines the custom property on .rdp descendants. The strip uses `style={{ width: 'var(--rdp-cell-size)' }}` but resolves to the var's initial value (empty), so flexbox collapses each button to its content width (~28px). Result: column centers diverge by up to 36px from the calendar header columns (M T W T F S S DO NOT sit above MO TU WE TH FR SA SU). This is exactly the symmetry the iteration intended to deliver.

issues: Strip and calendar visibly misaligned: strip is narrower and centered, while calendar columns spread wider — first/last day-letters sit roughly halfway between calendar columns instead of directly above them.

action_items: FIX desferal strip alignment: either (a) move `--rdp-cell-size: 42px;` declaration to `:root` (or to `.soft-card` / the parent of both strip and calendar) so the strip can resolve var(--rdp-cell-size); OR (b) hard-code width: 42px on each strip button; AND (c) verify the resulting cell width actually matches the live rendered calendar column width — the calendar headers measure ~40px center-to-center even with --rdp-cell-size=42px, so consider using the same exact value (e.g. read computed style of a .rdp-head_cell at runtime, or set both to 42px and add box-sizing if needed) to guarantee centers match within 2px.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/index.css L135-140: --rdp-cell-size is scoped to .rdp only. Any sibling component that wants to align with the calendar (like the desferal weekly strip) cannot read it. Promote it to :root.

/app/frontend/src/components/DesferalTracker.jsx L80: relying on var(--rdp-cell-size) from outside the .rdp tree silently fails. Add a fallback: width: 'var(--rdp-cell-size, 42px)' would at least give 42px even when the var is unresolved.
Minor: Diet weekly chart is hidden when no data exists for the week — fine, but the tooltip handler returns null on empty payload which avoids ghost tooltips (good).
Minor: Transfusion calendar has navBtns ≥ 2 (prev/next chevrons) confirmed via .rdp-nav; default caption label 'April 2026' present — symmetry with desferal calendar OK.

rca of the issue: BUG: Desferal weekly strip cells collapse to ~28px instead of 42px. RCA: CSS variable `--rdp-cell-size: 42px` is declared on the `.rdp { ... }` selector (only inside the calendar), but the weekly strip lives OUTSIDE the `.rdp` DOM subtree. CSS custom properties inherit from ancestors, so siblings cannot read it. When DesferalTracker.jsx applies `style={{ width: 'var(--rdp-cell-size)' }}` to each strip button, the var resolves to its initial (empty) value and the flex item shrinks to its content width (~28px). REPRO: open Ferritin tab → inspect any [data-testid='desferal-day-YYYY-MM-DD'] button → getBoundingClientRect().width returns ~28px instead of 42px. MITIGATION: Move the `--rdp-cell-size: 42px` declaration into `:root { ... }` (or onto the shared `.soft-card` parent that wraps both strip and calendar). Alternatively pass a literal `width: 42px` (with `var(--rdp-cell-size, 42px)` fallback). Then verify horizontally that calendar header cells also render at 42px — if DayPicker overrides the value internally to 40px, also pass weekStartsOn and explicitly set `style={{ '--rdp-cell-size': '42px' }}` on the DayPicker root so both render at the exact same width.
